## Modified or removed upstream files

| ------------------------------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |

| `.github/workflows/ringrtc.yml`                  | Use public GitHub-hosted runners instead of Signal-only larger-runner labels.             |
| `bin/build-desktop`                              | Build and exercise the fork-owned post-APM WebRTC processor test.                         |
| `bin/gsync-webrtc`                               | Apply the Minutes WebRTC patch queue after synchronizing WebRTC sources.                  |
| `src/node/index.ts`                              | Export the versioned Minutes recording-tap API types.                                     |
| `src/node/package-lock.json`                     | Lock the renamed compatibility package and its Minutes distribution dependencies.         |
| `src/node/package.json`                          | Publish @minutes/ringrtc and install checksum-pinned Minutes native prebuilds.            |
| `src/node/ringrtc/Service.ts`                    | Expose thin Node bindings for audio and outgoing screen-share video taps.                 |
| `src/node/scripts/fetch-prebuild.js`             | Remove the upstream artifact downloader from the Minutes compatibility package.           |
| `src/node/scripts/prepublish.js`                 | Validate the Minutes package identity, API version, assets, and checksums before release. |
| `src/rust/src/electron.rs`                       | Add the Electron FFI boundary for versioned bounded audio/video recording taps.           |
| `src/rust/src/lib.rs`                            | Register the fork-owned audio_tap and video_tap Rust modules.                             |
| `src/rust/src/webrtc/audio_device_module.rs`     | Install the post-APM local audio processor and remote playout observer hooks.             |
| `src/rust/src/webrtc/ffi/audio_device_module.rs` | Expose the WebRTC audio processor callback required by the post-APM tap.                  |
| `src/rust/src/webrtc/peer_connection_factory.rs` | Wire fork-owned tap state into the existing WebRTC factory without recording policy.      |

## Required sync review

1. Resolve merge conflicts without discarding upstream behavior.
2. Keep native tap logic in fork-owned modules; upstream files contain glue only.
3. Run `python3 bin/minutes_patch_manifest.py check --include-working-tree`.
4. Run the focused Rust, Node distribution, and manifest tests.
5. Record user-visible fork changes in `MINUTES-CHANGELOG.md`.
